# Parley v0.1.16

This test beta supersedes v0.1.15 and keeps the same explicit ad-hoc,
unnotarized trust model. The whole delta is one change set: a supervised
cross-vendor delegation review loop built on the existing handoffs, Status
Center and reviewed Context Packs, with no new workflow model, window or
store.

## Delegation visibility

- Shows owned facts for each active or recently returned delegation: time
  since the recorded delivery, the age of the latest agent-declared progress
  note with its bounded text, and the age of the target pane's last
  authenticated hook signal.
- States **No explicit update for 10 minutes** as information once neither a
  progress note nor a hook signal has arrived in that window. Nothing is
  inferred from silence, and no estimate, readiness or completion is shown.
- The default Delegate recipe asks the target to post milestone progress and
  to return substantial results with `parley done current --file <path>`.

## Linked Request Changes

- Adds a native **Request Changes** action on a returned Delegate result and
  the lead-pane form `parley delegate <target> --parent <handoff-id>`. Each
  creates exactly one linked Delegate child recorded with relationship
  `requestChanges`; it is never a verdict, and human verdicts remain
  native-only.
- A pane credential may name only a parent it initiated or received; the
  parent must be a Delegate with a returned result; ordinary target
  resolution and busy refusal apply, and a linked child is never queued.
- Status Center renders the thread Delegation → Result → Request changes →
  Revised result from owned receipts, and the Markdown export preserves the
  same thread and linked children.

## Bounded Git facts per delegation

- Records a path-only snapshot of the target pane's working folder at
  delegation and again at done or fail: the HEAD revision, the branch or
  detached state, and a sorted list of dirty paths capped at 200, read with
  one fixed `git status` argv. No file contents, diffs or authorship are read.
- Shows **N paths changed since delegated** as the difference between the two
  dirty-path lists, calls out HEAD movement and truncation, and labels it
  **shared worktree: not attribution** because other panes and the person edit
  the same tree. Nothing here says who changed a file.
- A non-Git folder records nothing. A missing folder, unreadable repository
  or timed-out read is informational only and never changes a delegation's
  outcome. Capture runs outside the coordination lock, and a delegation
  cancelled during capture is never submitted.
- Paths are shown with control and format characters visibly escaped in
  Status Center and the export; raw paths stay exact for comparison.

## Completion evidence in `done --file`

- Documents one plain Markdown template with the headings **Implemented**,
  **Tested** (each command and its claimed outcome) and **Unable to test**
  (with the reason), in the engineering guide and the in-app help.
- Status Center renders those headings, in any order, as one **COMPLETION
  EVIDENCE** block labelled AGENT-DECLARED, reading only the exact file the
  target returned. Unknown headings are ignored, the first duplicate wins, and
  a file without the headings renders exactly as before.
- Every section is shown as an unchecked claim. Parley runs no command and
  verifies nothing automatically.

## Review and correct recipe

- Adds one built-in lead recipe, **Review and correct**, as an editable prompt
  template and nothing more. It guides the lead through Delegate → milestone
  Progress → returned Result → review by a different vendor → linked Request
  Changes → independent verification, and asks the implementer for the
  completion-evidence headings.
- The recipe requires at least two explicit non-lead target panes from
  different vendors and refuses a single target or a same-vendor-only
  selection before anything is sent. Ordinary Delegate and Compare targeting
  is unchanged.
- Locally edited recipes are preserved: a valid v0.1.15 four-recipe preference
  file migrates additively to the new format, keeping every edit and adding
  only the new recipe.

## Upgrade notes

- Quit Parley before replacing the existing application. Quitting ends its live
  pane processes and app-resident coordination core.
- Workspace definitions, folder attachments, layouts, recipe edits and
  collaboration history remain compatible.
- The shared agent protocol is v15. Existing v14 panes must restart before
  using the linked `--parent` form; Parley shows them as needing a protocol
  restart, and a full application upgrade naturally recreates agent panes as
  stopped placeholders.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.16-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app`
  in Applications, and reopen it from Finder.
- This test beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. After first trying to
  open it, use **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when
  the files came from this expected GitHub release. Never disable Gatekeeper.
- Automatic replacement and the Homebrew cask are intentionally unavailable
  for this test beta.

Use `Parley-0.1.16-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
